verdict.rationale: Postman CLI is explicitly documented for running test collections with reporters, and docs directly state it can be used to run collections as part of CI/CD pipelines, including combining with the Postman API for CI/CD integration; Newman is also cited as a CLI runner. Postman CLI exit codes/reporters imply build-failure-on-regression support, though evidence doesn't explicitly show exit-code/build-fail configuration details. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exit code behavior on test failure and a third-party CI pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions config) showing build failing on regressions.
